jobs.occupation: Sales Associate - Chocolate Boutique - Bruges City Centre
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting opportunity in the heart of Bruges?

Do you want a job with real growth potential? Are you passionate about customer service and working with high-quality products?

Then this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

This renowned chocolate boutique, located in the historic centre of Bruges, specialises in premium Belgian chocolate and offers customers an authentic chocolate experience.

The shop is known for its wide selection of pralines, truffles, and other handcrafted chocolate delicacies, all made with passion and craftmanship.

We are currently looking for an enthusiastic and customer oriented Sales Associate to join their team.

Your daily responsibilities:

• Welcoming and assisting customers
• Replenishing stock and maintaining attractive product displays
• Handling payments and operating the cash register
• Providing information about the product range
• Performing accurate stock control and monitoring expire dates
• Maintaining a warm and welcoming attitude at all times

• Perfect English and basic Dutch, but willingness to learn
• Willingness to work weekends (1 day off during the weekend)
• Evening work: in July & August, closing time is 10 PM (maximum 11 closing shifts per month)
French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese are also languages we are looking for.

The company is a not-for-profit making organisation which represents large, medium and small companies across Europe.

Jobomschrijving

Mission of the role:

In this role, you will provide efficient support the Executive Director Innovation in the execution and achievement of his tasks primarily in area of agenda management and email communications.

The successful candidate will frequently interact with high level internal and external contacts and assistant the Executive Director in the daily management of the Innovation team.

Are you inspired by these responsibilities?

For the Executive Director, you will:
	
• Independently manage his agenda and efficiently co-ordinate the arrangement of meetings, travel, etc.	
• Sort emails, answers questions within the framework of certain instructions; transfer more complex issues to the appropriate persons in absence of the Executive Director	
• Organize and manage all logistical elements related to international/internal/external meetings, presentations, seminars, events, visits….	
• Provide general administrative support within broad guidelines (e.g. making presentations, translating letters and documents).	
• Manage the Extranet/Website.	
• Perform basic accounting tasks of specific budgets	
• Provide support with HR-related issues including onboarding new team members.	
• Ensure the administrative interlink with the other  departments.

Can you make the difference?

The successful candidate will be an experienced professional who demonstrates the following experience and competencies:
	
• A minimum of 5 years of work experience, preferably as an assistant at senior management level	
• Excellent written and oral communication skills	
• Proficiency in IT, web management and social media skills	
• Excellent level of English, written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is an asset.	
• Full proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)	
• Excellent time management and organisational skills with the ability to prioritise work accordingly	
• Excellent interpersonal skills and customer orientation	
• Understanding of underlying issues and proactively developing and evaluating solutions

Looking for an international environment? Do you possess strong B2B communication skills? Then this technical support role within the medical device sector is looking for you! Here in Machelen, you will be handling incoming communication from internal and external stakeholders and be responsible for:

• Following strict internal guidelines to ensure a high level of reporting quality for medical matters.
• Processing and updating projects in SAP.
• Monitoring POs and shipments.
• Escalating more complex problems to the specific departments, which could be regarding accounting or more technical issues. It depends on the problem!
• Logging and archiving of reports and contracts.
• Backup for other administrative tasks.
 

• You communicate fluently in English AND Italian or Spanish.
• In possession of a university degree and a Belgian working permit
• Experience within larger company structures is a plus.

International Operations Manager - UK
The International Operations Manager - UK is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the company's overall business operations in the UK market, including retail operations, people management, B2B and B2C sales, marketing, events, inventory, budgeting, compliance and business development.

The role ensures the stable, efficient and compliant operation of the UK business while supporting sustainable sales growth, market development and the expansion of the company's K-beauty activities in line with its European and global strategy.
Key Responsibilities
• Oversee the operation of stores, showrooms, pop-up locations and other offline sales channels in the UK, ensuring operational standards, service quality and customer experience.
• Manage local staffing, including recruitment, onboarding, training, work allocation, scheduling and performance follow-up.
• Develop and implement B2B and B2C sales strategies and identify new distributors, retailers, commercial partners and business opportunities in the UK market.
• Maintain and develop relationships with existing clients, distributors and strategic partners.
• Develop and implement annual and quarterly commercial and marketing plans in coordination with the European organisation and Korean headquarters.
• Plan and execute promotional campaigns, trade fairs, pop-up stores, customer events and partner events, including budget, logistics and performance evaluation.
• Conduct market research and monitor competitors, consumer trends, pricing, distribution developments and K-beauty market opportunities.
• Set sales targets and KPIs, monitor commercial performance and prepare regular management reports and recommendations.
• Analyse sales results, customer feedback and market developments and implement actions to improve business performance.
• Prepare and manage operating budgets, monitor expenses and identify opportunities to improve profitability and cost efficiency.
• Manage sales forecasts, ordering, stock levels, logistics and inventory flow to ensure appropriate product availability.
• Monitor legal, administrative and regulatory requirements applicable to UK operations, including product sales, cosmetics, retail, employment and consumer protection.
• Coordinate with external advisers, service providers, suppliers and relevant authorities and monitor the quality and delivery of their services.
• Identify key operational, commercial and regulatory risks and report significant matters to senior management.
• Work closely with the Korean headquarters, the European entity and other country teams to align UK operations with the company's regional and global strategy.
• Develop and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency, profitability, market presence and long-term business growth.
• Act as the main operational point of coordination for the UK market and support management in strategic and commercial decision-making. Candidate Profile
We are looking for a candidate with strong international business awareness and practical experience who can manage business operations, sales, marketing and K-beauty-related activities in the UK market in an integrated manner.

This position requires continuous communication and coordination between the Korean headquarters and the UK and European teams. The successful candidate should therefore combine a strong understanding of the K-beauty industry with practical capabilities in business development, marketing and operations.
Essential Requirements
• Very high level of Korean proficiency, sufficient to conduct business discussions with the Korean headquarters, prepare reports and documents, and manage day-to-day business communication effectively
• Advanced business English proficiency, sufficient to conduct meetings, negotiations and operational coordination with UK-based employees, clients and business partners
• Proven experience conducting business meetings with English-speaking stakeholders, partners and local employees, including preparing meeting minutes and business reports in English
• Degree or professional education in Economics, Business Administration, Media Technology, Digital Content, Cultural Content or a related field
• Relevant professional experience in marketing, business development, brand management, sales or a related area
• Professional experience in overseas K-beauty markets, including brand marketing, distribution, sales or business development
• Practical experience using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), or relevant certification, with the ability to analyse and report on website traffic, conversions and marketing performance
• Practical understanding of B2B and B2C business models and distribution structures
• Experience planning and managing online and offline marketing campaigns, promotions or events
• Ability to update website content and manage basic website operations
• Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, consumer trend analysis and identify new business opportunities
• Ability to analyse sales and marketing data and propose actions to improve business performance
• Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with headquarters, local employees, external partners, suppliers and service providersPreferred Qualifications
• Experience living, studying or working in Korea, with an understanding of Korean business culture and working practices
• Experience in business, marketing, distribution, sales or brand operations in the UK or European market
• Experience participating in K-culture or K-content-related projects, such as international film festivals
• Experience supporting the international expansion, localisation or overseas marketing of Korean brands or Korean consumer products
• Qualification or practical experience in video production or video editing
• Understanding of and practical ability to work with photography, video, social media and digital content
• Experience using CMS or other website management systems
• Proficiency in additional foreign languages beyond Korean and English
• Experience working in multicultural and international business environmentsKey Competencies
The successful candidate should understand the business and cultural differences between Korea and the UK/European markets and be able to effectively adapt the Korean headquarters' business strategy and brand direction to local market conditions.

The candidate should also be able to connect sales, marketing, partner management and business operations through a strong understanding of the K-beauty industry and local consumer market, contributing to market expansion, revenue growth and the stable operation of the company's UK business.

jobs.occupation: Relationship Support Associate - 6 months contract - M/F/X
jobs.description:
The Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) role involves supporting corporate banking processes with precision and efficiency. This position requires a strong command of English and attention to detail to ensure effective operations.

Client Details

The company operates in the financial services industry and is located in Brussels.

Description

As a Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking), your responsibilities are:

• Manage and process corporate banking transactions accurately and on time.
• Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
• Collaborate with internal teams to resolve operational issues effectively.
• Monitor and report on operational performance metrics.
• Support the implementation of process improvements to enhance efficiency.
• Maintain accurate records and documentation for all transactions.
• Assist in the preparation of operational reports and analyses.
• Provide support for audits and other compliance activities.Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking)

A successful Relationship Support Associate (Corporate Banking) should have:

• A strong command of English, both written and spoken.
• Bachelor or Master degree, preferably in finance or similar.
• Experience or knowledge in the financial services industry.
• Proficiency in using banking systems and tools.
• The ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.
• A commitment to maintaining compliance and operational accuracy.
• Applicants must already be based in Belgium and possess valid authorization to work in Belgium at the time of application.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?
Would you like to join an international working environment?
Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

One of the most important players in the bank sector in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

In charge of the control of KYC files : based on local and cross-border requirements and internal  process: 
	
• adverse info check	
• analysis of the information received	
• collaboration with the KYC Coordinator to ensure the respect of deadlines	
• treatment of partial triggers

Collaboration with the KYC Coordinator, the Middle office and/or with compliance departments to discuss potential issues and find solutions.
Communicate on the progress  (and in case of potential difficulties)  with the team leader.
Communications to colleagues will be done in French, Dutch or English.
 

	
• Dutch: Fluent	
• French: Fluent	
• English: Good knowledge (understanding, writing and speaking)	
• Minimum Bachelor education or equivalent by experience	
• At least  5  years of experience.	
• Technical experience: IT tools (Excel, Outlook, Word, PDF)	
• Business experience:  Relevant education (economical, juridical, business management), preferably also commercial experience

Our client is a leading Belgian dealer and service partner for commercial vehicles, vans, and trucks, with multiple locations across East and West Flanders, including Brugge, Ardooie, Bavikhove, Deinze, and Aalter. The company is known for its expertise, customer-focused approach, and commitment to quality service.

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for a Diagnostic Technician to join a growing and stable automotive company specializing in vans and trucks. Brand experience is not important. What matters most is your diagnostic knowledge and ability to identify and solve technical issues efficiently.

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will be responsible for:
	
• Performing advanced mechanical, electrical and electronic diagnostics on vans and trucks using diagnostic equipment and vehicle software.	
• Identifying faults and determining the most efficient repair strategy.	
• Repairing and adjusting mechanical, electrical and electronic systems based on diagnostic findings.	
• Communicating diagnostic results and completed repairs clearly to workshop management and service advisors.

Candidate Profile
	
• Passion for automotive technology and troubleshooting.	
• Technical education in automotive engineering, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent practical experience.	
• Good knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and diagnostic software.	
• Experience with diagnostic equipment is required.	
• Experience with a specific vehicle brand is not necessary.	
• Experience with vans, commercial vehicles or trucks is an advantage.	
• HEV1 certificate is a plus.	
• Analytical, accurate and problem-solving mindset.	
• Candidates must be able to communicate in Dutch or English.

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

• You are customer-oriented

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are pragmatic and have the capacity to keep things simple

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.

As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.

You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.

• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative.
